evidence.claim: The SEC-filed annual report establishes the sponsored-ADR identity, five-ordinary-share ADR ratio, business model, audited baseline economics, customer concentration, capital intensity, and geopolitical and overseas-fab risks used in the review.

SEC-filed issuer exhibits report Q2 revenue of NT$1.270 trillion, net income of NT$706.56 billion, 67.7% gross margin, 60.3% operating margin, USD4.31 diluted ADR EPS, 77% advanced-technology wafer revenue, and strong Q3 and full-year guidance.
The SEC-filed issuer release reports July revenue of NT$467.58 billion, up 5.6% month over month and 44.7% year over year, with January-July revenue up 37.0%.

The SEC-filed resolutions approve approximately USD29.44 billion of capacity appropriations across advanced technology, packaging, specialty capacity and fab infrastructure, plus participation in the Sony venture for not more than JPY282 billion.
evidence.source: TSMC Board of Directors Meeting Resolutions, August 11, 2026

evidence.claim: The SEC-filed binding agreement targets Kumamoto image-sensor volume production in 2029, with Sony control, phased TSMC cash contributions of approximately JPY282 billion, and additional investment considered on the premise of Japanese government support.
evidence.source: Sony Semiconductor Solutions and TSMC definitive joint-venture agreement
